name: Sahana
source:
A gifted young girl and the only person her misanthropic Onii-chan—a light novel author and the story's protagonist—has ever truly opened his heart to.

Too intelligent for her own good, with unnaturally pale skin and snow-white hair, she has always stood out. Unable to fit in at school, she withdrew from the world, much like Onii-chan.

More closely than anyone else, she quietly watches over him as he begins his career as a light novel author.

She wants Onii-chan she loves more than anyone to become successful. And yet, the thought of him becoming popular also fills her with sadness.

Deep down, she believes they'll remain together until the very end, no matter what happens. Because of that, she sees the quiet life they share as "an extraordinarily slow form of suicide"—a thought so calm and matter-of-fact that it is all the more unsettling.

[From [url=https://x.com/__your_sister__/status/2075274924672139630]official profile[/url]]
